provenance.notes: Witness-backed d<=56 only; no exact-distance claim. Distance revised 2026-08-19 by GPU deep refutation with the board's standalone ris_gpu tool (verify/ris_gpu.cu, sqetch kernels by Muzhou Ma, MIT) on an NVIDIA L40S: a 1,000,000,000-trial random-ISD recovery ladder per side (seed 88000007) committed a weight-50 X logical and a weight-50 Z logical, both re-verified on the CPU with the repo's GF(2) arithmetic and recorded here as the new per-side witnesses. This tightens d<=56 to d<=50 and the score from 102*56^2/502 = 637.15 to 102*50^2/502 = 507.97. The distance remains a witness-backed upper bound, not an exact-distance claim. @npdeep constructed the code. Refutation credit and the search budget are recorded in witness_provenance on each corrected side (schema 0.2, issue #611); authorship is unchanged.
